project: CE 393 Plate No. 2 - Proposed Two-Storey Residential Building
design_type: U-shaped return stair with an intermediate half-landing

floor_levels.basis: Provisional design assumption only. The assignment/repository does not yet specify final floor-to-floor height. Replace with the accepted building section levels before architectural drawing coordination.

geometry.envelope_basis: Two clear 0.90 m flights plus a nominal 0.20 m central separation allowance; each flight needs 2.24 m of tread run and a 0.90 m half-landing depth, totalling 3.14 m. The 2.00 x 3.20 m zone is a planning envelope, not finished wall-to-wall dimensions.

checks.nbcp_landing_depth_minimum_basis: At least the clear width of the stair flight, subject to the applicable straight-run/landing provision.
checks.bp344_accessible_stair_applicability: VERIFY. The base concept is for a private Group A dwelling stair and is not represented as an accessible staircase. Where the revised 2024 BP 344 IRR requirements for an accessible staircase apply, redesign is required; the published accessibility requirements include 150 mm maximum risers, 300 mm minimum treads, 1.50 m clear width, landings at least 1.50 m deep, and complementary ramp/lift/escalator along an accessible route.
checks.headroom_check: At least 2.00 m clear from the plane parallel to tread nosings to the soffit; verify in the detailed building section.
checks.handrail_check: Target 0.85 m above tread nosings under NBCP stairway guidance; verify final handrail/guard requirements. Where BP 344 applies, additional accessible handrail and tactile provisions are required.

limitations: Floor-to-floor height is a design assumption, not source-given data.
No beam, slab, stringer, reinforcement or stair structural design is included.
The nominal space envelope is not a dimensioned construction drawing.
Confirm applicable NBCP IRR provisions, BP 344 applicability, instructor criteria, structural depth, headroom and final room layout before freezing stair geometry.

references.name: Presidential Decree No. 1096, National Building Code of the Philippines, Section 708(h)
references.use: Group A dwelling stair requirements; verify the provision against the adopted building rules and local official interpretation.

references.name: Presidential Decree No. 1096 / NBCP stairway provisions
references.use: General stairway width, rise/run, landings, handrails and landing interval provisions.

references.name: National Council on Disability Affairs, 2024 Revised IRR of BP 344
references.use: Accessibility review; applicability to the specific dwelling and stair route must be determined before finalizing.
